node.statement: Top-slab companion: for an exact signed idempotent P with 0 < delta(P) <= (17 - 12*sqrt(2))/2, nonempty visible set W(P), and hidden top vertex v of height H > 13*tau (tau = sqrt(delta)), there is a row f with ||p_f - p_v||_1 >= 4*tau and dist_1(p_f, conv{p_w : w in W}) > H - (1/2 + delta)*tau.
